# Assam Rifles Public School, Jorhat (ARPS Jorhat)

> Official portal for ARPS Jorhat, providing academic, administrative, and admission information.

## Primary Links

- [Academic Calendar](/academic-calendar): Schedule of academic activities, exams, holidays, and school events for the academic year 2025-26.
- [Holiday List](/holiday-list): Official vacation schedule and list of holidays for the year.
- [Admission Procedure](/admission-procedure): Process, requirements, guidelines, and fees structure for new student admissions.
- [Fees Structure](/fees-structure): Stream-wise and class-wise fee schedules.
- [Online Registration](/online-registration): Portal for online admission registration and candidate applications.
- [Transfer Certificate](/transfer-certificate): Guidelines and application requests for student school leaving/transfer certificates.

## Departments & Infrastructure

- [Faculty](/faculty): Directory of teaching faculty across different departments (Humanities, Science, Commerce).
- [Staff](/staff): Non-teaching staff directory including administrative, library, accounting, and auxiliary teams.
- [Laboratory](/laboratory/computer): Science and technology labs including Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Computer Labs.
- [Classrooms](/classrooms): Visuals and details of smart-enabled digital classrooms.
- [NCC](/ncc): Details of the school's affiliation with the 9 Assam Battalion National Cadet Corps.
- [Academic Achievements](/academic-achievements): Board toppers, ceremony highlights, and felicitations by honorable dignitaries.
